{{Quote|Ran into one of Zenjo's guys. Left him a scar, but he's still breathing.|[[Anspi'shel]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Zenjo''' was a criminal active on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], which [[Anspi'shel]] ran into as she escaped the [[Exchange]] holding cell she was previously kept. She fled the cell out into the [[Corellian Sector (Nar Shaddaa)/Legends|Corellian Sector]] of the moon, which was also primarily Exchange territory, eventually running into one of Zenjo's men, managing to evade them long enough to reach [[Mezenti Spaceport]].
